character.name: 曹军祭师 / Cao army ritual priest
character.desc: Elderly stern Chinese man with long silver beard, black formal squared ritual cap with small red knot, orderly dark burgundy ceremonial robe with brass edging over black chest guard, broad cloth sash, small bronze ritual bell in left hand and paper charm in right. Upright military ritual silhouette.
character.special: detonate curse, raise bronze bell overhead and thrust paper charm forward then recoil

visual_review: Selected after full-source visual inspection; exported idle, move, attack, special and independent head subsequently inspected. All body frames independently drawn; hit reuses reviewed idle poses.
